findings.namedBuyers: Shan Tao — Director, Founding Strategic Partner and VP, Strategic Outreach & Sponsorship; founder of MADE GOOD IMPACT Inc. Strong first contact for a lodging/brand partnership because Little Canada identifies MADE GOOD IMPACT as leading the 2026 Sheraton collaboration. Blur Wu — Founder and Chairman of the festival nonprofit; President of SPARK Media, an event planning, marketing and AV-production company. Relevant executive escalation and referral route for production-team lodging. Neither person is verified as the hotel-contract signatory or housing buyer. Use the published shared address info@torontospringfestival.ca and request routing by name; no personal email or phone is verified here.
findings.futureEdition: Official 2027 edition page, reviewed October 2, 2026, explicitly announces public festival February 6–7, 2027 at Nathan Phillips Square, Toronto City Hall, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. February 5 is exhibitor setup, not a public festival day. The sponsorship page corroborates this distinction. The generic homepage headline says February 5–7 and retains mixed 2026/2027 content; use the explicit edition-specific clarification for activity dates. No official 2028 edition announcement was located; do not derive an event date from Lunar New Year itself.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown is a possible city-hotel base for an organizer-confirmed subset of visiting performers, production crew, sponsors, VIPs or families, not exclusive housing for the forecast 60,000–80,000 festival visits/attendees. Its 157 guestrooms and 19 suites could support a modest separately qualified group; no 15–109-room requirement or any other block size is evidenced. Harbourfront positioning is not the event site and MTCC walkability adds no event-specific advantage. Small planning meetings may fit the supplied meeting-space limits, but the outdoor festival itself does not. This is not a resort-led event. Do not promise catering, restaurant service, shuttle service or fireworks views; these are unverified.
findings.venueCommitments: Organizer-announced venue: Nathan Phillips Square, Toronto City Hall, 100 Queen Street West, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. This is Toronto proper, downtown civic-centre territory, not Harbourfront, MTCC or Exhibition Place and not a hotel. City Council adopted relevant Nathan Phillips Square event permissions for the October 2026–April 2027 period, including Toronto Spring Festival, on June 24–25, 2026. Fireworks and other activities remain subject to the specified permits; neither the venue rental contract nor final permits were published in the reviewed material.
findings.historicalRotation: 2025 inaugural public festival: January 25 at Nathan Phillips Square, Toronto City Hall. 2026 second edition: February 14–15 at the same square, with fireworks February 15 at 9 p.m. 2027 is announced at the same venue. This establishes recurrence and venue continuity across three editions, not destination rotation or a guarantee of future annual dates.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 lodging sourcing is unconfirmed: no edition-specific housing bureau, host-hotel allocation, room block, open hotel RFP or room-night commitment was located. A real historical hotel partnership exists for 2026: the official Mini & Magic Passport page states, "Purchasing the Passport grants you access to an exclusive rate for the Sheraton 'Firework-view Room'" and "Offer valid for stays between Feb. 14th–16th, 2026." The hotel is Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel, 123 Queen Street West, independently named by partner Little Canada. This is a dated promotional rate/package-access pathway, not evidence of contracted block volume or exclusivity. Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel is the only hotel named in an edition-specific organizer/partner lodging offer located. No other hotel block was verified. The homepage still displays this second-edition collaboration; it must not be promoted as a 2027 commitment.
findings.organizationStructure: The organizer identifies itself as Toronto Spring Festival Committee (spelled Commitee on its edition page); its committee biography describes Toronto Spring Festival as a nonprofit founded and chaired by Blur Wu. This is a community cultural-festival organization, not an association congress. Wu also leads SPARK Media; Shan Tao founded MADE GOOD IMPACT Inc., which led the historical hotel/attraction collaboration. These commercial affiliations do not establish ownership of the nonprofit, exclusive PCO appointment, or hotel-contract authority. Nathan Phillips Square/City of Toronto is the venue/municipal permissions counterparty, not the lodging buyer.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel has an evidenced 2026 promotional relationship and a published fireworks-view offer at 123 Queen Street West, a material historical incumbent advantage for this City Hall event. This does not establish 2027 exclusivity or that all lodging is committed elsewhere. No sourced sellout, overflow requirement, room pickup, displacement or unsatisfied demand was located. Generic nearby-hotel recommendations were not treated as commitments.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Email info@torontospringfestival.ca addressed to Shan Tao, copying/requesting introduction to Blur Wu. Reference the 2026 Mini & Magic/Sheraton collaboration and ask whether it renews for February 2027, whether exclusivity covers organizer/performer/crew lodging, and who actually buys accommodation. Request arrival/departure dates around February 5 setup and February 6–7 public activity, nonlocal traveler counts, peak rooms, room nights, budget, transport needs, existing hotel commitments and decision deadline. Offer a small-group proposal only after those needs and hotel availability are confirmed. Do not buy a sponsorship booth as a proxy for room demand; if 2027 is closed, request the next hotel-partner review date without assigning a 2028 event date.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The 2027 festival is announced and within the requested horizon, but access to organizer-controlled lodging business is unverified. The organizer publishes an active 2027 sponsorship/corporate-participation contact route; it does not publish an open accommodation tender. The only verified hotel offer is historical, for February 2026. Approach for qualification and routing, not as a live RFP or a confirmed overflow lead.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: the 2026 hotel/attraction collaboration demonstrates that a commercial hotel relationship is possible, making Shan Tao a relevant route to ask about 2027 supplementary lodging or a later-edition partnership. Radisson should position as a distinct Harbourfront small-group base rather than a substitute fireworks-view hotel. Later-cycle capture is conditional on recurrence and buyer confirmation; there is no verified 2028 event date, rotating-host program or future open sourcing window.
